$comment: Read by scripts/test-runner.mjs. knownFailures: tests that fail on origin/main today, each identified by the WHOLE fingerprint - file, exact title, node's failureType and messagePattern (a regular expression over the first line of the failure message); a failure whose title is listed but whose type or message differs is reported as a new failure, a listed test that passes is reported title by title so an entry is removed in the PR that fixes it; an entry for a secret / credential scan test is refused by the runner. fileOptions.testTimeoutMs: node's per-test limit for one file. knownNoExit: files whose process stays alive after every test finished. kindOverrides: a file mapped to a kind when the static classification is wrong, with the reason in kindOverrideNotes.

kindOverrideNotes.http-parser-security.test.mjs: imports the real app with an unreachable loopback URL solely to construct its lazy pool; pool.query is replaced before app import with a fail-fast counter and asserted unused; only parser rejection and unauthenticated routes, no database connection
kindOverrideNotes.production-static-serving.test.mjs: spawns the real src/server.js in production mode, whose /api/health runs select now(); it needs a reachable local server and nothing else, so it runs with the maintenance database as its target and creates nothing
